nodes.label: Frozen Continuous-Recording Stage P2 Feature Cache
nodes.rationale: Stage P3 transition learning consumes fingerprinted, frozen P2 features from complete recordings so recurrent state is preserved and representation learning is isolated from transition-head learning.

nodes.label: Physical-Time Gaussian Transition Supervision
nodes.rationale: Boundary targets are generated in physical seconds and paired with consecutive cached updates, avoiding frame-index supervision that would drift with the configured frame period.

nodes.label: Balanced Within-Split Semantic Pair Sampling
nodes.rationale: Deterministic same-event, same-class, and different-class nascent/mature pairs are balanced within each split to train semantic change detection without cross-split leakage.

nodes.label: Monotonic Verify Training Trajectories
nodes.rationale: True boundaries, shifted candidates, short spikes, and within-event comparisons expose the Verify head to positive trajectories and hard temporal negatives.

nodes.label: Isolated Physical-Semantic-Verify Head Training
nodes.rationale: The four transition heads are trained sequentially with phase-specific gradients, metrics, checkpoints, and early stopping so each detector has a dedicated supervision regime.

nodes.label: Validation-Only Latency-Gated Threshold Calibration
nodes.rationale: Controller thresholds are selected only on validation results that satisfy a 1.2-second confirmation-latency gate, prioritizing 0.72-second F1 before over-segmentation and 0.36-second F1.

nodes.label: Test-Once Evaluation Guard
nodes.rationale: An exclusive marker binds one immutable test evaluation to the threshold fingerprint, preventing repeated peeking and accidental threshold iteration on the test split.

nodes.label: State-Conditional Online Latency Diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Complete recordings are evaluated causally, and synchronized timing separates active, candidate, and control-commit update costs to expose latency hidden by aggregate averages.

nodes.label: Shared Streaming-Commit Event Memory
nodes.rationale: Streaming and commit paths share parameters and the same residual-update core; only update granularity and relative-time encoding differ, while an outer convex gate retains the previous event state.

nodes.label: Fixed-Prompt KV Cache Reuse
nodes.rationale: Qwen's invariant event prompt is encoded once and cloned per stream/commit update, avoiding repeated prompt computation while preventing cache mutation across branches.

nodes.label: Stateful RD-Point Radar Tokenization
nodes.rationale: Independent causal TCNs preserve continuous history for RD and point-cloud branches, while query pooling and transformer fusion emit a fixed four-token update at 5 Hz.

nodes.label: Micro-Doppler-Guided Dual-TCN Fusion
nodes.rationale: Motion features modulate RD maps through identity-initialized FiLM, while separate RD and MD causal TCNs retain complementary spatial and micro-Doppler history before resampling.

nodes.label: Backend-Neutral Four-Token PARrad Contract
nodes.rationale: The default dual-TCN, MD-only RadMamba, and MD-only GRU encoders expose the same state, masks, frame features, and four-token interface so downstream stages remain backend-independent.

nodes.label: Causal Micro-Doppler GRU Baseline
nodes.rationale: Right-padded packed sequences and explicit hidden-state carry make MD-GRU chunking equivalent to a continuous forward pass while preventing padding from advancing state.

nodes.label: Causal Selective State-Space RadMamba Baseline
nodes.rationale: A forward-only selective state-space model carries convolution, SSM, and position state without future leakage, providing a causal alternative to recurrent MD-GRU.

nodes.label: Boundary-Aware PARrad Activity Pretraining
nodes.rationale: Temporary frame and token classifiers warm up the PARrad encoder, while smoothness is applied only inside true label runs; the classifiers are excluded from deployable encoder export.

nodes.label: PARrad Semantic-Warmup and Joint Training Contract
nodes.rationale: Warmup learns the event-memory stack before captions are introduced; joint training then enables only selected adapter parameters while keeping the radar encoder frozen and finetuning it under a separate small learning rate in the trainer.

nodes.label: Streaming-Commit Radar-Language Alignment
nodes.rationale: The same event memory is trained through online streaming and whole-event commit paths, with symmetric text alignment, cosine consistency, and causal caption generation.

nodes.label: Pose-Guided Radar Pretraining
nodes.rationale: A temporary frame-resolution pose head supplies MPJPE and velocity supervision, then is omitted when the deployable radar encoder is exported.

nodes.label: Fast-Slow Prototype Change Detection
nodes.rationale: Event-local fast EMA and slow Welford statistics turn physical update duration into prototype age and variance features, allowing stable and rapid change signals to coexist without cross-event leakage.

nodes.label: Candidate Semantic Verification
nodes.rationale: Candidate rejection fuses semantic difference, three-key stability, and maturity through positive weights, enforcing monotonicity with respect to every verification feature.

nodes.label: Stage P3 Four-Head Phase Isolation
nodes.rationale: Physical change, semantic difference, and monotonic Verify heads share no trainable phase: set_phase freezes every head outside the active phase.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Stage P3 Cache Fingerprinting
nodes.rationale: Checkpoint, configuration, manifest, schema, dtype, shape, and content hashes must all match before cached features are accepted, preventing silent training on stale or corrupted supervision.

nodes.label: Contiguous-Recording Training Orchestration
nodes.rationale: PARrad training and evaluation carry detached state across chunks of complete recordings, reset only between recordings, and never choose chunk boundaries from labels.

nodes.label: MD-GRU Causality and Padding Contract
nodes.rationale: Tests require future-independent outputs, chunk/full equivalence, padding-neutral hidden state, factory configurability, and omission of unused RD payloads.

nodes.label: RadMamba Causality and State Contract
nodes.rationale: Tests require MD sensitivity and gradients, no future leakage, chunk/full equivalence, padding-neutral state, MD-only PARrad behavior, and TBPTT detachment without resetting time.

nodes.label: Gemma 3 Prefix-Adapter Compatibility Contract
nodes.rationale: Tests pin native hidden-state equivalence, local sliding-window handling, event-prefix logits, q/v-only LoRA targeting, backend selection, tokenizer setup, and dtype propagation.

nodes.label: Fork-Shadow Online Controller Contract
nodes.rationale: Tests require one active candidate fork, frozen references, exact no-replay rejection, proposal-time boundary ownership, short-candidate rejection, one encoder call per update, clean reset, and post-inference boundary evaluation.

nodes.label: Deterministic Transition-Head Test Doubles
nodes.rationale: Constant local, radar, semantic, and Verify modules isolate controller state transitions and threshold behavior from learned-model variability.
